intents.useCaseName: Sign in with a system-issued username and start a session

routeInsteadTo.request: log me in / sign me in as someone else
routeInsteadTo.goesTo: No intent. The login screen only.
routeInsteadTo.note: Credentials are entered on /login by the person holding them.
